# Termux Terminal Components

Upstream:
https://github.com/termux/termux-app

Pinned commit:
4584488513c099f2e98bcfcd00f006d213248729

Vendored components:

- terminal-emulator
- terminal-view

Purpose:

Provide the proven terminal emulation, scrollback and viewport
foundation used by AppForge Terminal.

AppForge-specific PTY, multi-session, Git, SSH, Files,
Connections, Tools, security and product logic remain AppForge code.

Upstream source headers and licensing must be preserved.
See TERMUX_LICENSE.md.
